annotations.title: Change events across plans: recordkeeper switches, new plans, mergers, terminations...

description:
Change events detected by comparing each plan's consecutive filings, newest filing first. Each event
has before/after values, a confidence, the year compared against, a plain-English detail and the ACK ID
of the filing that shows it.

Providers are compared by family, so a rebrand (Great-West → Empower) isn't a change. Each event also
has the plan's size around the event (`net_assets_at_event`), which `min_assets` and `sort=assets` use.
The newest plan year is still being filed, so its counts grow month to month.

Price: $0.25 per call, paid in USDC on Base (mainnet) with x402 (MCP transport). Without payment the tool returns the payment requirements. Errors and empty results aren't charged.

Same data as GET /changes of the Plan Data API.

ein.description: Only this sponsor's plans (EIN, 9 digits, dashes allowed): what changed at one company.
ein.title: Ein

event_type.description: Event type(s); repeat the parameter or separate with commas. One of: recordkeeper_change, advisor_added, advisor_removed, advisor_changed, auditor_change, audit_opinion_change, late_deposits_appeared, new_plan, plan_merged_in, plan_merged_out, plan_terminated, termination_resolution, filings_stopped, large_asset_jump. Meanings at `get_coverage`.
event_type.title: Event Type

filer_size.description: large or small, in the event's plan year.
filer_size.title: Filer Size

from_recordkeeper.description: Only recordkeeper_change events away from this recordkeeper family (any brand name). Combine with `to_recordkeeper` for one move, e.g. Empower to Fidelity.
from_recordkeeper.title: From Recordkeeper

limit.description: Events per page (1-50). Each event is about 200 tokens of JSON, so the default 25 keeps an answer compact; narrow the filters rather than asking for more.
limit.title: Limit

min_assets.description: Minimum net assets around the event (`net_assets_at_event`: the larger of the event year's start and end).
min_assets.title: Min Assets

min_confidence.description: Lowest confidence to include: high = high only, medium = high and medium, low = all.
min_confidence.title: Min Confidence

plan_type.description: Plan type, as in `search_plans` (e.g. 401k, dc, db).
plan_type.title: Plan Type

plan_year_from.description: Earliest plan year of the event.
plan_year_from.title: Plan Year From

plan_year_to.description: Latest plan year of the event.
plan_year_to.title: Plan Year To

recordkeeper.description: Only recordkeeper_change events to or from this recordkeeper family (any brand name works).
recordkeeper.title: Recordkeeper

since.description: Only events whose filing DOL received on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD): "what's new since I last checked". Excludes filings_stopped, which no filing reveals.
since.title: Since

sort.description: newest (the default: newest filing first) or assets (largest plan first, by `net_assets_at_event`).
sort.title: Sort

state.description: Two-letter state of the sponsor (latest filing).
state.title: State

to_recordkeeper.description: Only recordkeeper_change events to this recordkeeper family (any brand name).
to_recordkeeper.title: To Recordkeeper
